# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): architecture, conventions, how to verify a change and the safety rules of this project. Before changing behaviour, read [docs/DECISIONS.md](../docs/DECISIONS.md) (why things are the way they are) and, for Azure DevOps API work, [docs/AZURE_DEVOPS.md](../docs/AZURE_DEVOPS.md).

Keep these documents current as part of every change (see "Keeping these documents current" in AGENTS.md): README.md for user-visible changes, docs/DECISIONS.md for decisions and their reasons, docs/AZURE_DEVOPS.md for verified API facts, and AGENTS.md itself when the architecture, commands or conventions change.
